name: windows-live-connector
description: Give Claude access to your personal Microsoft Account's OneDrive and Outlook Mail via Microsoft Graph.
long_description:
Local MCP server giving Claude Desktop access to a personal Microsoft Account's OneDrive and Outlook Mail via Microsoft Graph.

Auth is OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE (public client, no secret) - the connector never sees your password.

Token storage is encrypted at rest and fails closed. On macOS the token cache is AES-256-GCM encrypted under a key held in your login Keychain, reached through the built-in `security` tool rather than a compiled native module - so nothing here depends on a binary matching your exact Node build. On Windows the cache is DPAPI-protected. If neither is usable, the connector refuses to sign in rather than writing refresh tokens to disk in the clear; upgrading from an earlier version also re-seals and deletes any plaintext cache that version left behind.

You will need to register a free Microsoft Entra app once (no admin consent, no verification, no cost) and paste its Application (client) ID in during setup - instructions are shown in the configuration field below.

Teams is intentionally out of scope: Microsoft Graph does not expose Teams chat APIs to personal Microsoft accounts.

Safety properties:
- Sending mail and deleting files are separate, clearly-annotated destructive tools; Claude is instructed to confirm with you before calling them.
- Deletes go to the OneDrive recycle bin, never permanent.
- Recipient addresses and subjects are validated before use; line breaks and control characters are rejected.
- Attachment saves cap at 25 MB, file reads at 100 MB; filenames are sanitized.
- stdout carries only MCP protocol traffic; all diagnostics go to stderr (visible in Claude Desktop's MCP logs).

client_id.title: Microsoft App (client) ID
client_id.description: Register a free app once at https://entra.microsoft.com -> Applications -> App registrations -> New registration. Supported account types: 'Personal Microsoft accounts only'. Platform: 'Mobile and desktop applications', redirect URI 'http://localhost'. Then paste the 'Application (client) ID' from the app's overview page here. The same registration works unchanged on both Windows and macOS.

tools.name: ms_login
tools.description: Signs in to your personal Microsoft account via an interactive browser-based OAuth flow (authorization code + PKCE); the connector never sees your password.

tools.name: ms_logout
tools.description: Clears the cached Microsoft account and tokens for this connector.

tools.name: ms_whoami
tools.description: Reports whether a Microsoft account is currently signed in, which account it is, and when the current access token expires.

tools.name: mail_list
tools.description: Lists messages from a mail folder (default inbox), newest first.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Searches messages across the mailbox using a relevance-ordered query.

tools.name: mail_read
tools.description: Fetches the full content of a single message, including a plain-text body and attachment list.

tools.name: mail_get_attachment
tools.description: Downloads a single file attachment from a message and saves it to disk (max 25 MB).

tools.name: mail_create_draft
tools.description: Creates a new draft message (not sent) - the preferred way to compose email for review before sending.

tools.name: mail_send
tools.description: Sends an email immediately and irreversibly, either newly composed or from an existing draft.

tools.name: mail_move
tools.description: Moves a message to another mail folder.

tools.name: mail_mark
tools.description: Updates the read state and/or flag state of a message.

tools.name: onedrive_list
tools.description: Lists the children of a OneDrive folder (files and subfolders).

tools.name: onedrive_search
tools.description: Searches OneDrive for items matching a query, optionally scoped to a folder.

tools.name: onedrive_get_metadata
tools.description: Fetches full metadata for a OneDrive item: size, timestamps, web URL, hashes, etc.

tools.name: onedrive_read_file
tools.description: Reads a OneDrive file's content - small text files inline, others saved to disk (max 100 MB).

tools.name: onedrive_upload_file
tools.description: Uploads a local file to OneDrive, using chunked upload sessions above 4 MB (max 250 MB).

tools.name: onedrive_create_folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder under a given OneDrive parent path.

tools.name: onedrive_move
tools.description: Moves and/or renames a OneDrive item.

tools.name: onedrive_delete
tools.description: Deletes a OneDrive item to the recycle bin (recoverable, never permanent).
